sourceAuthority.operatorName: Centre de Données astronomiques de Strasbourg

providers.name: SIMBAD Astronomical Database
operations: bounded ICRS cone query over SIMBAD basic objects

analyses.inputRows: 1-500 strict astrometric measurement rows with exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.uncertainty: SIMBAD-style proper-motion error ellipse covariance plus first-order delta propagation and normal 95% intervals

analyses.inputRows: 5-2000 strict irregular time-series rows with explicit astronomical time system, nullable values/errors, use flags, and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: weighted floating-mean generalized Lomb-Scargle least-squares sinusoid over an inclusive linear frequency grid
analyses.uncertainty: inverse-variance weighting when explicitly resolved as weighted; missing errors are preserved and never imputed; Baluev analytic FAP upper bound and Montgomery-O'Donoghue period standard error are reported when numerically resolvable
outputs: Baluev analytic FAP upper bound when resolvable
Montgomery-O'Donoghue period standard-error estimate when resolvable

analyses.inputRows: 5-2000 strict irregular time-series rows with explicit astronomical time system, nullable values/errors, use flags, and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: weighted floating-mean generalized Lomb-Scargle extended with Baluev analytic FAP, seeded permutation bootstrap, local peak refinement, period uncertainty, alias screen, and two-harmonic refinement
analyses.uncertainty: analytic frequency/period error from Montgomery–O'Donoghue, local peak-width error, and optional seeded residual-bootstrap period standard deviation

analyses.inputRows: 8-5000 normalized relative-flux observations with explicit time system, uncertainties, use flags, and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: exact data-resolution Box Least Squares search over inclusive period and duration grids with inverse-variance or explicit unweighted statistics
analyses.uncertainty: weighted box-depth standard error or unweighted out-of-transit scatter; secondary-eclipse and odd/even diagnostic screens

analyses.inputRows: 1-2000 astrometric/radial-velocity rows with explicit errors and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: Johnson–Soderblom heliocentric and LSR UVW transformation with first-order uncertainty propagation and a Toomre diagram
analyses.uncertainty: first-order propagation from parallax, proper-motion, and radial-velocity errors with an explicit uncorrelated-parameter assumption
notComputed: population assignment beyond the declared likelihood screen

analyses.inputRows: 1-5000 photometric/parallax rows with explicit errors, optional caller-declared extinction/locus, and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: naive inverse-parallax absolute magnitude with first-order error propagation and comparison against a strictly increasing caller-declared locus
analyses.uncertainty: photometric, parallax, and declared extinction/reddening errors combined by first-order propagation

analyses.inputRows: 0-500 explicit positive redshifts plus an optional 2-2000 point positive-redshift grid and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: flat Lambda-CDM numerical quadrature following Hogg (1999) for comoving, angular-diameter, luminosity, time, volume, and angular-scale quantities
analyses.uncertainty: none; rerun with alternative declared cosmological parameters to bracket systematic sensitivity

analyses.inputRows: 3-500 broadband photometry rows with effective wavelengths, declared flux convention, errors/use flags, and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: deterministic temperature-grid seed followed by Levenberg–Marquardt fit of a single Planck blackbody temperature and solid-angle scale
analyses.uncertainty: covariance estimates with chi-square inflation when reduced chi-square exceeds one

analyses.inputRows: 8-5000 radial-velocity observations with explicit time system, errors, use flags, and exact source-content SHA-256
analyses.method: GLS period seed followed by multi-start Levenberg–Marquardt single-Keplerian fit over period, semi-amplitude, eccentricity, argument, periastron, and systemic velocity
analyses.uncertainty: covariance estimates with reduced-chi-square scaling plus first-order minimum-mass propagation when a primary mass is declared
outputs: mass function and optional m sin i

limitations: SIMBAD is an astronomical object database, not a general catalogue or complete survey; absence from a cone result is not evidence that no object exists.
Only the fixed basic-object ten-column projection is exposed. Arbitrary ADQL, uploads, async jobs, joins, provider pagination, and alternate endpoints are not accepted.
The cone is ICRS in decimal degrees and is bounded to 10 degrees and 500 objects per request.
JSON, CSV, and TSV normalize to the same canonical object projection. Null and empty optional provider values remain null and are never imputed.
The exact successful HTTP response bytes are hashed but are not embedded in the normalized result.

The kinematics analysis does not fetch missing uncertainties. It accepts explicit uncertainty fields, preserves absent values as null, and excludes incomplete rows from inference rather than imputing them.

Distance is the naive inverse of a positive parallax, not a Bayesian distance estimate. First-order delta uncertainties are withheld from inference when declared fractional-error thresholds are exceeded.
The proper-motion error ellipse supplies component covariance, but parallax-proper-motion covariance is unavailable and is explicitly assumed to be zero.
The publication figure is a deterministic Vega-Lite payload; this plugin does not bundle or claim a renderer/export runtime.

The basic period analysis is a single-sinusoid weighted floating-mean generalized Lomb-Scargle grid search. It reports a Baluev analytic false-alarm upper bound and a Montgomery-O'Donoghue period standard-error estimate when numerically resolvable; these are model estimates, not calibrated detection probabilities or confidence intervals. A returned FAP of 0 is a numerical floor, not exact certainty.

The periodicity-depth extension adds seeded permutation FAP, local/analytic/bootstrap uncertainties, alias diagnostics, and a two-harmonic refinement. Those diagnostics remain bounded by their declared white-noise, sampling, time-system, and model assumptions; no red-noise correction, detrending, transit model, or more than two harmonics is applied.
Astronomical time systems are preserved exactly as declared by the caller and are not converted. BJD, HJD, JD, MJD, UTC, and TDB must not be treated as interchangeable.
No renderer is bundled. The host may render the normalized rows in its existing table or sky-coordinate surfaces without implying survey completeness.
